title: Provision the missing Wildheart free-domain alias and verify canonical redirects

source.ref: Daniel November 4 audit and approved launch scope

detail:
The audit found wildheart.frequencylocal.com points to Vercel but fails TLS, and its alias is absent from the verified project-domain list. Attach and verify only the intended free alias through the established provider workflow. Verify the certificate, root and nested-page permanent redirects, and canonical destination. Preserve the working custom site and the existing admin, API, booking-confirmation, Spotlight and chapter exceptions.

── 2026-11-09 18:53Z owner step done: `npx vercel domains add wildheart.frequencylocal.com frequency-web` returned Success; the domain is on the frequency-web project. The Vercel CLI route needs no API token when the CLI is signed in. Still to verify before closing: trusted TLS, root and nested-page permanent redirects, canonical destination, custom site unchanged.

verify.evidence: 2026-11-09: owner ran `npx vercel domains add wildheart.frequencylocal.com frequency-web` (Success). Owner opened https://wildheart.frequencylocal.com in a browser and landed on wildheart.academy with no certificate warning, so the alias has a trusted certificate. Production read 19:10Z: wildheart.frequencylocal.com/calendar?utm_source=ig... -> 308 https://wildheart.academy/calendar with the supported tags kept. Owner confirmed /events lands on wildheart.academy/events; that page is a correct 404 (the site has no events page, its calendar is /calendar) and its platform-header 404 is split to LIVE-SITE-NOT-FOUND.
